description: Wave 8 Post-Release Hardening Performance Gates — tighter thresholds and new operability gates.

hard_gates.description: Large-value (512 KiB) read p99 must not exceed 175 µs.
hard_gates.rationale: Tighter than W7 (200 µs) to reflect optimised storage path; regression beyond 175 µs indicates a critical storage path regression.

hard_gates.description: Concurrent audit log write throughput must sustain ≥ 90 000 ops/s.
hard_gates.rationale: Audit logging is on the hot write path; below this rate, write-heavy workloads lose audit coverage.

hard_gates.description: Read p99 threshold tightened to 175 µs for W8.
hard_gates.rationale: Confirms storage-path improvements in W8 cycle hold the tighter bound.

hard_gates.description: Write-storm throughput under 8-thread peak load must sustain ≥ 60 000 ops/s.
hard_gates.rationale: Ensures write-storm SLA is maintained under concurrent load typical of peak ingest bursts.

hard_gates.description: All W8 benchmarks must report a gate_passed counter (triage_completeness = 1.0).
hard_gates.rationale: Benchmarks without gate_passed counters produce no CI signal; 100% coverage is required.

hard_gates.description: At least 80% of hard gate IDs must have a corresponding runbook entry with description and rationale.
hard_gates.rationale: Ungated incidents are harder to triage; 80% runbook coverage is the minimum for release sign-off.

soft_gates.description: Read workload coefficient of variation should stay below 5%.
soft_gates.rationale: High CV indicates measurement noise that may mask regressions.

soft_gates.description: Write/delete cycle throughput must not drift more than 5% across iterations.
soft_gates.rationale: Drift beyond 5% signals memory leak or fragmentation growth.

soft_gates.description: Key sequence determinism must produce zero mismatches.
soft_gates.rationale: Non-deterministic key generation invalidates cross-run comparisons.

known_limitations: IRS-07 and THD-07 use RocksDB stub latency until a real production storage backend is wired; actual p99 values may differ from stub measurements.
ORP benchmarks use in-process registry simulation; real triage decisions involve filesystem and network I/O not captured here.
W8B THD-06 concurrent write load uses std::thread without CPU affinity; variance on NUMA systems may be higher.
DCH-05 clock resolution depends on CI runner hardware; measurements on shared VMs may show coarser granularity than bare-metal.
ORP-07 triage_completeness of 1.0 is asserted by count; tooling must verify each benchmark executable at release time.
